headline: From 1 October 2026, a housing loan interest subsidy policy for residents will be implemented, tentatively for one year
summary: China's Ministry of Finance will implement a housing loan interest subsidy policy for residents from 1 October 2026. The policy is tentatively set to run for one year.
why: Mortgage support measures influence household borrowing and the property market, which is a major driver of China's economy.
